recent_calls.summary: The user called and was quickly transferred to a live agent for further assistance. The initial agent informed the user about the transfer before completing it successfully.

Levy called to report a gas leak smell coming from the furnace installed by the company. The gas company and emergency services have already been contacted, and the agent escalated the issue to an emergency specialist for a callback after failing to transfer the call directly. The user declined further assistance and ended the call.

The user called to inquire about the cost of a new AC unit. The agent attempted to assist but then transferred the call to a live agent for further help. The call lasted 19 seconds and ended with a successful transfer.

The user called to inquire about a scheduled appointment that was supposed to occur at 9:30 but had not yet happened, and she was unsure if anyone would call or come. The agent attempted to assist by transferring the call to a live agent for further help.

The user, Rochelle Keaton, called to confirm the time of her appointment. The agent was unable to find the appointment in the system and offered to transfer her to a live representative, which the user accepted. The call ended with a successful transfer to a live agent.
The user returned a call from Amy and was promptly transferred to a live agent for further assistance. The call lasted briefly and ended with a successful transfer.

The user called back after being disconnected from a previous agent named Amy and requested to be reconnected. The agent, Sophie, acknowledged the request and successfully transferred the call to another live agent.
The user called and requested to speak with someone, and the agent promptly transferred the call to a live agent for further assistance.

The user called on behalf of a customer to inquire about air filters but did not have the service address ZIP code needed for the agent to provide specific information. The agent explained that the ZIP code is required to check availability and offered to assist further once the ZIP code is provided. The call ended without the user providing the ZIP code or requesting follow-up.
The user, Colin, returned a call from CJ and was promptly transferred to a live agent for further assistance. The transfer was completed successfully without any issues.
The user called and provided their ZIP code 63021, then requested to speak with a representative. The agent confirmed the information and transferred the call to a live agent for further assistance.

The user called to reschedule an appointment related to an American Home Shield cooling repair service. The agent gathered necessary details and then transferred the call to a live agent for further assistance.

The user, Colin Testra, called to report an immediate issue with their air conditioning unit, which is not turning on. The agent successfully booked a technician appointment for the same day at 2 PM. The user confirmed the details and expressed satisfaction with the booking.

The user called to cancel a previously scheduled AC appointment. The agent acknowledged the cancellation and confirmed that the request would be passed to the team. The call ended politely with no further requests from the user.

Sam from American M Show called Budget regarding a dispatch and requested to speak with a live agent. The initial agent, Sophie, confirmed the nature of the request and then transferred the call to a live agent for further assistance.
The user requested to speak with a live person, and the agent promptly transferred the call to another agent. The transfer was successful, and the call ended shortly after.

The user called to cancel an appointment scheduled for tomorrow afternoon. The agent confirmed the cancellation and assured the user that the request would be passed to the team. The call ended with no further requests from the user.

The user reported that the air conditioner previously fixed is not working again. The agent confirmed the user's contact information and attempted to verify the service address, but the user corrected the address. The call was then transferred to a live agent for further assistance.
The user called Budget and requested to speak with a representative. The agent, Sophie, promptly transferred the call to a live agent for further assistance.
The call was very brief with only the agent greeting the user and no further conversation. The user hung up shortly after the greeting without any interaction.

The user, Karen, returned a phone call and was quickly transferred to a live agent for further assistance. The initial agent acknowledged the return call and facilitated the transfer without completing a detailed conversation.
The user called and requested to speak with a live order representative. The agent attempted to connect the user but the call ended abruptly shortly after.

Patricia Edmiston called to report a broken heat pump and provided details about her service address, issue, and warranty dispatch number. The agent confirmed the information and informed her that someone from Budget Heating, Cooling & Plumbing would contact her soon for service. Patricia declined information about maintenance programs and feedback requests.
The user requested to speak with a live agent, and the initial agent promptly transferred the call to another agent. The call ended shortly after the transfer was completed successfully.

The user, Justin Sherwood, called to schedule a regular repair service for a non-working AC unit. The agent successfully booked an appointment for the next day at 8 AM and provided details about the dispatch fee. The user declined to provide an email and declined to give feedback.
The call was very brief and ended abruptly after the agent's initial greeting and request for the user's ZIP code. The user hung up before providing any information or engaging further.

Levy called to report a possible gas leak involving both the furnace and stove, requesting a technician to check them after the gas company visit. The agent confirmed the details, including the service address and warranty information, and informed Levy that the request was prioritized for follow-up during regular business hours. The call ended with the agent assuring Levy that the team would contact him on the next business day.

The user called to inquire about Budget's opening hours and appointment availability. The agent provided the hours and explained that same-day appointments couldn't be confirmed before opening, offering to take details for a callback. The user declined and said they would call back later.

Antonette called to arrange payment for her air conditioner repair using a different card than the one on file. The agent confirmed her request and scheduled a callback for the next business day at the earliest time. The call ended with no further requests from Antonette.

The user called to inquire about the pickup of equipment from their house. The agent collected the user's name, phone number, and full address to pass the request to the team for follow-up on the next business day. The call ended with the user expressing appreciation and no further requests.

Richard Scott called Budget Heating, Cooling & Plumbing to schedule a service appointment for his air conditioner to check and possibly add Freon. The agent scheduled the service for as soon as possible the next day and offered information about maintenance programs, which Richard declined. Richard provided positive feedback about the virtual assistant's clarity and knowledge.

The user, Greg Tallian, reported that his newly installed AC failed for the second time and he currently has no cooling during extreme heat, which could be an emergency. The agent acknowledged the urgency, flagged the situation as urgent, and informed Greg that the team will contact him first thing the next business day since it was after hours. The call ended with the user satisfied and no further requests.

The user, Tanisha Moulton, called to schedule a service appointment for her air conditioner which is blowing warm air instead of cold. The agent collected her service address, contact information, and preferred appointment timing, and confirmed that the team will reach out on the next business day to confirm the earliest available appointment.

The user, Steven Tehan, called after hours requesting emergency HVAC service at his address in Saint Louis, Missouri. The agent could not connect him to a live representative but took his information and assured a callback on the next business day. The call ended with the user confirming no further assistance was needed.
The user called Budget's after-hours assistant to discuss a warranty claim and provided their ZIP code. The call ended shortly after the user expressed their intent to talk about the warranty claim.

The user called to inquire about purchasing a fan motor, but the agent explained that they do not sell individual parts directly. The agent offered to have the service team contact the user to discuss repair or replacement options, but the call ended before the user responded.

Antonette called to schedule an urgent air conditioning cleaning with Brianne due to her AC being out in hot weather. The agent documented the request as urgent and informed her that the team will contact her on the next business day since it was after hours. The call ended with no further requests from Antonette.

The user, Linda, called Budget Heating, Cooling & Plumbing regarding an air conditioner repair and confusion with her warranty company. The agent documented her issue and service preferences, including a request for a call before 9 AM the next day, and offered information about home maintenance programs, which Linda accepted. The call ended with the agent confirming that the team would follow up soon to assist.

The user called after hours to clarify if a technician would come out today as previously indicated. The agent explained that after 4 PM calls are handled by a virtual assistant who collects information for follow-up the next business day and cannot confirm same-day service. The agent assured the user's request would be documented for the team to review.

Jessica called to check on the status of a technician appointment for her non-working air conditioning on the hottest day of the year. The agent confirmed the urgency due to her children and dog at home and escalated the request as urgent for next business day follow-up, but could not dispatch a technician immediately due to after-hours. Jessica expressed frustration but did not request emergency transfer or additional contact.
The user called and was greeted by the agent Sophie, who then transferred the call to a live agent as requested. The transfer was completed successfully.
